title: Taiwanese Student Association at Ohio State University – 俄亥俄州立大學台灣同學會
content_html:
The Taiwanese Student Association (TWSA) at The Ohio State University — known in Chinese as 俄亥俄州立大學台灣同學會 — is a student-led, service-oriented organization dedicated to supporting and connecting Taiwanese students on the Columbus campus. Its founding year is not documented on available first-party sources. The organization is primarily oriented toward students who have come from Taiwan to study at OSU, and all board members are actively enrolled OSU students.

According to the organization’s official website, TWSA’s mission is “to create a home away from home for Taiwanese students by offering cultural, social, and academic support throughout their time at OSU,” while striving “to foster friendships, promote cultural exchange, and enhance the visibility of Taiwanese culture within the university community.” The organization maintains a Facebook group for member communication, a GroupMe for both undergraduate and graduate students, and is active on Instagram under the handle @osu.twsa.
